topic: Young anti-war and opposition supporters turned a Communist Party rally in Moscow into a protest against the September 2026 Duma election and the war
quote1: Besides the Communists themselves, young people unaffiliated with the KPRF unexpectedly turned out, including members of left-wing political groups and Yabloko supporters.
quote2: The party said in a statement that the detentions happened as the rally was ending, and that its Moscow branch was working to get those who were detained – mostly young people – released.
